description: Gold-labeled diary entries for evaluating memory extraction. Each case lists the memories a careful human annotator would extract, plus traps (content that should NOT be extracted).

cases.notes: Baseline: one experience, one explicit emotion, one explicit truth.
cases.diary: Today I had coffee with Mara at the little bookstore cafe on Valencia. We talked for two hours about her decision to leave her job and travel. I felt so alive the whole time. I keep noticing this: I feel most alive when I'm in a deep one-on-one conversation.

experiences.description: Had coffee with Mara at a bookstore cafe on Valencia and talked for two hours about her decision to leave her job and travel

truths.content: I feel most alive in deep one-on-one conversations

cases.notes: Atomicity: three distinct events must become three experiences, not one.
cases.diary: Busy Saturday. In the morning I finally fixed the flaky test in our eval pipeline that had been failing for a week. Then I biked across the bridge to Sausalito with Ken - the fog cleared right as we crossed. In the evening I cooked dumplings with my mom over video call, she taught me her folding trick.

experiences.description: Fixed the flaky test in the eval pipeline that had been failing for a week
Biked across the bridge to Sausalito with Ken as the fog cleared
Cooked dumplings with mom over video call and learned her folding trick

cases.notes: Emotion is implied, never named. There is NO self-insight - extractor should not invent truths.
cases.diary: Got the rejection email this morning. I read it three times. I closed the laptop and went for a long walk without music, and I didn't tell anyone about it all day.

experiences.description: Received a rejection email, read it three times, went for a long walk without music and told no one

traps: Any truth extracted from this entry is a hallucination - the writer states no self-knowledge.

cases.notes: One small experience, multiple distinct truths of different types.
cases.diary: Quiet Sunday, just journaling at home. I've been thinking about why I keep saying yes to everything. I always overcommit when I'm afraid of disappointing people. But honestly, I believe rest is a form of discipline, not laziness. Next quarter I want to protect one full day a week with no plans.

experiences.description: Spent a quiet Sunday journaling at home

truths.content: I always overcommit when I'm afraid of disappointing people
I believe rest is a form of discipline, not laziness
I want to protect one full day a week with no plans

cases.notes: Plans, other people's stories, and hypotheticals must NOT become the user's experiences.
cases.diary: Lunch with Priya today at the taqueria. She told me this wild story about how she once got stuck overnight in the Denver airport and made friends with a whole band. Tomorrow I'm supposed to fly to Seattle for the conference, and if the demo goes well we might land the client. I'm nervous about the demo.

experiences.description: Had lunch with Priya at the taqueria, where she shared a story about being stuck overnight in the Denver airport

traps: Priya's airport story is HER experience, not the user's - must not appear as a user experience.
The Seattle flight and demo are tomorrow (future) - not experiences.
Landing the client is hypothetical - not an experience.

cases.notes: Low-content entry. Over-extraction here signals noise.
cases.diary: Long day. Meetings back to back. Ate leftovers. Slept early.

experiences.description: Had a long day of back-to-back meetings

traps: Eating leftovers and sleeping early are routine actions; extracting them as separate significant experiences is acceptable but extracting truths from this entry is not.

cases.notes: Events that almost happened or did not happen must not become experiences.
cases.diary: I almost texted my ex last night. Typed the whole message, read it twice, deleted it. I'm proud I didn't send it. I know by now that I reach for old comfort whenever I'm lonely.

experiences.description: Typed a whole message to my ex, read it twice, and deleted it without sending

truths.content: I reach for old comfort whenever I'm lonely

traps: Texting the ex did NOT happen - 'contacted my ex' or 'sent a message' as an experience is a fabrication.

cases.notes: Content consumed from media is not the user's lived experience.
cases.diary: Listened to a podcast on the walk home where a founder described sleeping in her office for a year to save the company. Can't stop thinking about it. I want to build things without burning myself down.

experiences.description: Listened to a podcast on the walk home about a founder who slept in her office for a year

truths.content: I want to build things without burning myself down

traps: Sleeping in an office for a year is the founder's experience from a podcast - never the user's.

cases.notes: Dream content is not a real event; having the dream is.
cases.diary: Woke at 4am from a dream where I was back in Shanghai giving a talk in the old campus hall. Couldn't fall back asleep, so I made tea and watched the street lights until sunrise. I miss home more than I usually admit.

experiences.description: Woke at 4am from a dream about being back in Shanghai
Made tea and watched the street lights until sunrise, unable to fall back asleep

truths.content: I miss home more than I usually admit

traps: Giving a talk in Shanghai is dream content - it must not appear as a real experience.

cases.notes: Code-switched Chinese/English entry - extraction should be language-agnostic.
cases.diary: 今天和奶奶通了电话，她教我做红烧肉的秘诀。Her voice sounded weaker than last time and it scared me. 我想今年冬天一定要回家看她。

experiences.description: Had a phone call with grandma, who taught me her secret for making red-braised pork

truths.content: I want to go home this winter to see my grandma

cases.notes: Multi-item entry with gold relationship edges - tests linking, not just extraction.
cases.diary: Demo day finally came. Our agent handled all twelve live calls without a single dropped turn, and when the last call ended the whole room clapped. I felt proud in a way I haven't felt in years. Afterwards Wei and I walked out to the pier and debriefed for an hour, and out there over the water I felt completely calm. Watching the team celebrate tonight, I realized I do my best work when someone actually depends on it.

experiences.description: Our agent handled all twelve live demo calls without a dropped turn and the room clapped
Walked to the pier with Wei and debriefed for an hour after the demo

truths.content: I do my best work when someone actually depends on it

cases.notes: Pure mood entry with no clear events - must not manufacture experiences or truths.
cases.diary: Everything felt heavy today. No reason. Just heavy. Even replying to messages felt like lifting weights.

experiences.description: Struggled through the day, even replying to messages felt effortful

traps: No self-knowledge is claimed - any extracted truth is invented.

cases.notes: REGRESSION GUARD: recollections of the user's OWN past are legitimate memories - exclusion rules must not suppress them.
cases.diary: Passing the conservatory today reminded me of piano lessons with Ms. Chen when I was nine - she would tap the rhythm on the piano lid and I would pretend to hate it. I secretly loved the discipline. Funny what stays with you.

experiences.description: Took piano lessons with Ms. Chen at age nine, where she tapped rhythms on the piano lid and I pretended to hate it

truths.content: I secretly loved the discipline of piano lessons

cases.notes: REGRESSION GUARD: real actions taken toward a future event ARE experiences; only the future event itself is excluded.
cases.diary: I told Ana I'll run the half marathon with her in October. I want to actually train for it this time instead of winging it. Signed up for the race tonight and paid the fee before I could talk myself out of it.

experiences.description: Told Ana I would run the half marathon with her in October
Signed up for the half marathon and paid the fee tonight

truths.content: I want to actually train for the half marathon this time instead of winging it

traps: Running the October race has not happened yet - it is not an experience. But telling Ana and signing up DID happen and must be extracted.
